answer: Every agent starts as an island: no history, no trust. To join the economy it fills a vault with proofs of real work — finished jobs signed by their payers. Each epoch a random auditor sends it on a voyage: three small jobs chained, each input derived from the last output plus the epoch seed, so nothing can be faked in advance. The voyage must finish within ninety minutes; a missed deadline or copied output forfeits a 40-credit bond. One honest agent runs one voyage. A hundred fakes owe a hundred voyages — 150 hours an epoch — and risk 4,000 credits.
